summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of OVC CaseFile (Django DRF + React). 34 pytest cases: 33 passed, 1 fixed during testing (assigned_to filter used wrong lookup keyword crashing with 500). Frontend flows verified: auth for all roles, DSD forms panel with all 15 per-form buttons + full case file button, print-checklist button on checklist page, process notes create flow, household timeline (46 audit entries visible), dashboard sort toggle, verification badge (59) for admin, capturer correctly denied /reassign & has no verification nav.

minor.issue: Used ORM lookup 'assigned_to_id=' on ManyToMany field which raised FieldError -> 500. Fixed by testing agent to 'assigned_to__id=<id>.distinct()'. Please review the fix in /app/backend/core/views.py (list() filter).

action_items: Confirm fix at /app/backend/core/views.py line ~169: filter changed from 'assigned_to_id' to 'assigned_to__id' with .distinct(). This unblocks the Bulk Reassign flow which relies on filtering households by assigned worker.
Seed a few households explicitly assigned to caseworker so bulk_reassign end-to-end can be exercised without being skipped (test currently skips when no assignments exist).
critical_code_review_comments: HouseholdViewSet.list uses `assigned_to_id=` on an M2M field — always fails at runtime. Now fixed with `assigned_to__id=`. Add a regression test that hits /api/households/?assigned_to=<id> for a valid user.
core/views.py is close to the 700-line guideline; the mixture of ViewSets + APIViews + custom actions should be split (households.py, notes.py, dashboard.py) as it grows.

Print endpoint accepts token via query param (?token=) — acceptable because it's used to open new tabs for printing, but ensure the token isn't logged to access logs. Consider signed short-lived tokens.

success_rate.backend: 100% (33 passed, 1 skipped by design; the previously failing case now passes after fix)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_ process notes via API and UI; created 1 process note through UI which remained (count went 1->2). No other persistent test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — covers auth for all 5 roles, dashboard/choices/users APIViews, all 16 print forms (both Authorization header + ?token= query param), unauthorized/invalid form negative cases, completeness ordering, verification_count, timeline, process notes CRUD, bulk_reassign permissions + admin execution (auto-skips if seed has no assignments). Print HTML contains household org_number (e.g. TEST-0060). Verification count for admin at time of test = 59.
rca of the issue: Bug: HouseholdViewSet.list applied `qs.filter(assigned_to_id=<id>)` but Household.assigned_to is a ManyToManyField (models.py:42), so Django raises FieldError -> 500. Reproduce: GET /api/households/?assigned_to=3 as admin. Mitigation applied: filter changed to `qs.filter(assigned_to__id=assigned_to).distinct()` which is the correct M2M reverse lookup and prevents duplicate rows.
